BRND WGN 
 —
 We're a team fuelled by strategic thinking and creativity, dedicated to helping entrepreneurs craft meaningful brands that positively impact our world. We aid these brands in developing robust strategies, impactful designs, successful campaigns, engaging content, web development, and exceptional UX/UI. We also create bold brand experiences that make their names stand out.
 Our approach is defined by curiosity, simplifying complexities, and prioritising clarity. Our thinking leads us to do the unexpected and our approach makes room for powerful ideas. Our disruptive ways challenge the norm to deliver results, each and every time.
 Our Principles:
 👩🏻‍🎤 Challenge everything
 💙 Be brutally honest
 💪🏼 Find a way
 🏆 We win together
 A New Global Chapter:
 BRND WGN is building a dedicated team that will work directly with nmbl, a New York–based creative agency delivering world-class work for global brands such as Nespresso, Canon, and Vital Proteins.
 This collaboration gives our new team the opportunity to operate on fast-paced, high-impact international projects while being fully supported by BRND WGN ’s strategic and creative culture.
 THE POSITION
 —
 We're on the lookout for a Mid-Level Graphic & Motion Designer to join our expanding creative team.
 The Mid-Level Graphic & Motion Designer plays a key role in shaping and elevating the visual expression of the brands we work with. They bring together strong graphic design foundations and motion capabilities to develop brand systems, campaign concepts, digital assets, animated content, social visuals, and video-led creative that is not only well-crafted but strategically aligned.
 With a refined visual eye and strong conceptual thinking, they move confidently between creative ideation, design development, motion exploration, and execution. Working closely with Creative, Strategy, and Content teams, they help translate ideas into compelling visual solutions across static and motion-led touchpoints, while ensuring consistency, quality, and clarity throughout.
 Beyond delivery, the Mid-Level Graphic & Motion Designer helps raise the overall creative standard of the team—contributing insights, refining processes, and supporting the development of strong, scalable design and motion systems.
 Responsibilities:

• Design high-quality creative primarily for digital, social, and paid media, with occasional print applications.

• Develop and apply brand systems consistently across multiple touchpoints.

• Produce motion graphics and animated content for digital channels.

• Use AI-powered creative tools to improve ideation, workflows, and production efficiency.

• Collaborate closely with creative directors, strategists, copywriters, and account teams.

• Work effectively in a highly collaborative, small-team environment.

• Prepare production-ready artwork with exceptional attention to detail.

• Embody nmbl’s principles — collaboration, curiosity, honesty, and a solution-driven mindset.

 Requirements:

• 4–6 years of experience in graphic design, digital design, or brand identity work.

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma (motion or prototyping tools are a plus).

• Strong command of typography, layout, hierarchy, and design systems.

• Experience designing for social media and paid digital campaigns.

• Confident using AI tools as part of your creative workflow while maintaining a high standard of creative craft.

• Ability to think conceptually and translate strategy into compelling visual ideas.

• Experience working across multiple brands and projects in a fast-paced environment.

• Confident presenting and explaining design decisions to internal teams.

• Experience developing scalable visual systems and preparing assets for digital and social platforms.

• A strong portfolio demonstrating brand, campaign, and digital work.

 Software:

• Adobe Photoshop

• Adobe Illustrator

• Adobe InDesign

• Adobe After Effects

• Figma

• Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro

 Bonus Points:

• Experience creating content for performance marketing and paid social campaigns.

• Basic video editing skills.

• Familiarity with UI design in Figma.

• An interest in emerging creative technologies and AI-assisted workflows.

 Conditions:

• Working Hours: This role is aligned with our US-based team and requires availability within an approximate 7:00am–5:00pm ET coverage window.

• Travel Budget: €2,000 annual travel budget.

• Annual Retreat: Company-wide annual retreat to connect, collaborate, and spend time together.

• Location: Remote-first (optional office access in Malta)

• Salary Range: €40k+ annually (depending on experience)

 THE PERKS
 —
 This is a full-time role, and we offer competitive packages based on your experience and skills. Here's what you can look forward to:
 ⛑️ Health insurance
 📡 Remote Working Allowance
 👩🏻‍🏫 Professional Development Training
 💻 Dedicated Laptop
🅿️ Free Onsite Parking
🥯 Tea, Coffee and Snacks
🎉 Events
🍺 Monthly Team Meet-up
 🎄 Christmas Shutdown
 But more importantly, you'll be joining a group of talented individuals who are all passionate about pursuing brand excellence.
 LET'S CHAT 🤙🏼
